answer_2.quote: We employ HumanEval to evaluate models fine-tuned on Evol-instruction-66k dataset, using pass@1 as the evaluation metric. For the SQuAD dataset, Exact Match (EM) is utilized as the evaluation metric. Accuracy (acc) is used as the evaluation metric for all other tasks.
